candidate: Frozen low-node P11 prompt identification followed, for a positive selected prompt, by one selected-ID response anchor on the highest public component-influence eligible node excluding every node reserved in p11_probe_nodes. Unknown-node magnitude then uses distinct post-calibration selected-ID returns and excludes the low identification probe magnitude.
control: Reuse the already completed and independently audited original-P11 arm from the 252-case full-policy development raw report; never cache or synthesize the anchor arm.
cohort: The exact consumed 252 development cases: ten topology blocks, base/wide/close amplitudes, and all six prompt-ID permutations.

resources.ordinary: one informative probe node costs 6 and one anchor costs 2, total 8
resources.worst_case: two probe nodes after all-zero, clipping or failure cost up to 12; a subsequent anchor costs 2, total up to 14
resources.anchor_target: highest public component influence among untouched peace/neutral nodes with comm_left=3 and opinion strictly inside (-60,60), excluding all nodes reserved in p11_probe_nodes
resources.action_protocol: anchor is one legal LLM-selected action in one host step; failure or clipping does not update the anchor prior

primary_estimand: Average anchor-minus-original-P11 within each topology block first, then equally average the ten topology means.
gate: topology-weighted mean greater than 1 terminal unit
at least eight of ten topology means nonnegative
base, wide and close amplitude means all nonnegative
all 252 candidate episodes pass prompt identity, calibration/probe identity, action, planning, budget and public-history replay checks
early_abort: The first nonfinite gain or paired gain below -10 records rejected=true, aborted=true and complete=false, then stops. A partial run can never satisfy the development gate.
attribution_limit: Anchor action and transfer-prior composition change downstream communication/structure ordering; this is not a pure selector or pure two-budget effect.
decision: Passing remains development evidence only. Do not combine with the 0.9 discount and do not open 1401-1403 without a separate decision and frozen protocol.
